message.content:
A vertical editorial illustration on a yellow background features the large, stylized word "TEMPO" across the top. Below the title, two people are depicted from the torso up. On the left, a person with short dark hair, glasses, and a red collared shirt smiles. On the right, a larger person with short dark hair wearing a light beige short-sleeved button-down shirt looks upward. Their silhouettes are mirrored in a darker yellow tone in the background.

The text at the top reads, "DUGAAN SUAP GUBERNUR KEPULAUAN RIAU | MENJELANG TAMAT BANK MUAMALAT." Large black text in the center states, "BERSATU, BERCERAI, TEGUH, RUNTUH LAGI." Below this, smaller text reads: "Megawati merangkul Prabowo Subianto untuk mempersempit ruang gerak Surya Paloh dalam koalisi. Benarkah akibat rekrut paksa kader PDIP oleh Partai NasDem?"

At the bottom left, a white box contains a barcode, the number "00023", and the dates "29 JULI-4 AGUSTUS 2019." It also lists "RP 45.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN 0126-4273." A small "9 770126 427302" is also present. A solid red vertical border runs along the left edge.
